answer.says: Ramesh, you are the only institution in this house that has not yet collapsed into abstraction. I have no cash for the market, but I have the dignity of a man who has not eaten in twenty-four hours. Make the tea strong. We will sit, and we will discuss the state of the pot.
answer.thought: The empty pot is a concrete negation. It is not merely a lack of food; it is the failure of the system of needs to actualize itself in this specific household. I am the universal concept of the master, but I am also the particular body that requires rice. Ramesh holds the means of production, and I hold the title. We are in a dialectic of hunger.
